bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: In the spot forex market where true centralized exchange volume is not reported, tick volume measuring price change frequency serves as a proxy that is approximately 90% representative of true market activity.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: In the spot forex market we have a different problem. There is no true volume reported... tick volume (price change frequency) serves as a proxy... 90% representative in terms of the true 'activity'.

facts.statement: Time-based charts build candles across fixed temporal windows, whereas tick-based charts construct a candle only after a set number of transactions, making the speed of candle creation a visual proxy for market activity.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A time-based chart creates each candle across a fixed time window... By contrast, a tick chart (e.g., an 80-tick chart) builds a candle only after a set number of transactions/orders occur.

facts.statement: A selling climax occurs at the top of a bullish trend where insiders unload retail inventory to FOMO buyers, while a buying climax occurs at the bottom of a bearish waterfall where insiders absorb retail panic selling.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Selling Climax: Occurs at the top of a bullish trend or within market distribution where insiders unload inventory... Buying Climax: Occurs at the end of a bearish price waterfall or accumulation phase where insiders step in to buy.

facts.statement: Stopping volume features high or ultra-high volume on narrowing down-candles or hammers halting a sell-off, whereas a trap-up move is a manipulative gap-up or wide-spread up candle on low volume designed to lure weak longs.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Stopping Volume: High or ultra-high volume appearing on narrowing down-candles... Trap-Up Move: A manipulative move where market makers mark price higher on low or falling volume.

facts.statement: Under Wyckoff's Third Law of Effort vs. Result, volume effort must match price spread result; high volume yielding narrow price spreads signals an anomaly, extreme insider absorption, and an imminent trend reversal.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Effort vs. Result Law (Wyckoff's Third Law): Volume (Effort) must match Price Spread (Result)... high volume with narrow price spreads signals an anomaly and imminent reversal.

facts.topic: Machine Gun and Oil Tanker Analogies
facts.statement: Coulling compares high-speed tick chart printing during NFP releases to bullets fired from a machine gun, and likens a heavily trending market to an oil tanker that requires significant counter-effort to change direction.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Machine Gun Analogy: During major news releases like NFP... appear as if fired onto the screen from a machine gun... Oil Tanker Analogy: A heavily trending market is like an oil tanker moving at speed.

facts.topic: Telegraph Pole and Spawning Ground Analogies
facts.statement: An ultra-high volume bar towering over surrounding bars stands out like a telegraph pole signaling position clearing, while sideways congestion zones act as spawning grounds where new trends are born.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Telegraph Pole Analogy: An ultra-high volume bar... stands out like a telegraph pole... Salmon Spawning Ground Analogy: Sideways price congestion regions act as the spawning ground for new trends.

facts.statement: Because forex tick volume varies across broker feeds, absolute data accuracy is secondary to feed consistency, since VPA relies entirely on comparing current volume bars against historical bars on the exact same broker feed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Relative Consistency Over Absolute Data: Because forex tick volume varies between broker feeds, volume accuracy is less critical than feed consistency—you are always comparing one volume bar to previous bars on the same feed.

facts.statement: A multi-bar trend does not require volume to rise continuously on every single consecutive bar; as long as overall volume stays around or above average and avoids low-volume anomalies on rallies, the trend remains valid.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Flexibility in Trend Volume Analysis: A multi-bar trend does not require volume to rise continuously on every consecutive bar. As long as overall volume stays around or above average... the trend remains intact.

facts.statement: On an AUD/USD 15-minute chart, shooting star candles with high volume at higher highs signal institutional selling, allowing traders to confirm short entries with stop losses placed above the initial wick.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: AUD/USD 15-Minute Chart (Intraday Trade Execution): A wide-bodied candle formed with a deep upper wick on high volume, signaling insider selling... Confirmed short entry with a stop loss above the initial wick.

facts.statement: An AUD/USD weekly chart reveals an 18-month bull trend ending in a distribution anomaly where narrow-spread up candles printed near-zero volume, proving market maker withdrawal and preceding a major trend reversal lower.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: AUD/USD Weekly Chart (Selling Climax & Trend Exhaustion): Two wide-spread up candles printed near-zero volume... proved market makers had completely withdrawn from the rally... confirming a major trend reversal lower.

facts.statement: Silver and Gold ETF tick charts illustrate extreme selling pressure and stopping volume where massive institutional volume bars swamp average baselines, while coffee futures 80-tick charts highlight operator activity speed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Silver ETF (SLV 5-Minute Chart): Five consecutive down candles on rising, above-average volume... Gold ETF (GLD 15-Minute Chart): Massive selloff where individual candles carried volume exceeding 6 million... Coffee Futures (80-Tick Chart).

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
